assumptions: Annual figures are taken from 10-K/20-F/40-F filings only; duration facts are kept only when the period spans 300-400 days, which excludes the quarterly and year-to-date stubs that also appear inside a 10-K.
Where a figure was later restated, the most recently FILED version is used - the company's latest word on its own past.
Concepts absent from a company's filings are listed under concepts_unavailable and must never be treated as zero.
_meta.disclaimer: Research output, not financial advice. Figures marked basis=vendor_estimate or basis=projected are forecasts, not reported facts.

_provenance.notes: served from local cache; re-run with --refresh to force a new pull

fundamentals.concepts_stale_note: These tags exist in the filings but have not been updated in over ~13 months relative to the newest fiscal period. Their most recent value is NOT current and must not be used as a latest-year figure.
fundamentals.concepts_unavailable_note: These US-GAAP tags were not found in this company's filings. That is often legitimate - banks report no gross profit or capex, asset-light firms report no inventory. Downstream code must render these as 'DATA UNAVAILABLE OR UNVERIFIED', never as zero.

caveats: Only the most recent 25 Form 4 filings were examined; this is a recent-activity snapshot, not a complete history.
Codes A (grants) and F (tax withholding) are compensation mechanics and are NOT counted as buys or sells.
Sales are often pre-scheduled under Rule 10b5-1 plans and can be routine diversification rather than a signal. Check the filing footnotes before drawing any conclusion.
Derivative (option) transactions are excluded; only non-derivative share transactions are parsed.
